A tiny annual of wet gravelly flushes, basaltic seepages and open stony ground in cool upland situations.
Drying of flushes, trampling that removes the fine substrate, and heavy competition from taller vegetation can reduce population performance.

Continued seepage, light disturbance and limited competition are likely to maintain habitat suitability, whereas warmer drier summers could increase stress on the shallow wet substrates used by the species.
